title: Shifting coal frontiers: compound air pollution and heat risk around sub-Saharan African coal power plants: code and derived data
description: Python code and derived datasets for a satellite-based assessment of compound air pollution and heat risk around 25 coal power plants in sub-Saharan Africa, with a quasi-experimental evaluation of the 2023 Hwange Thermal Power Station expansion in Zimbabwe. Inputs are public TROPOMI, ERA5-Land, MODIS, WorldPop, Malaria Atlas Project, GHAP, Global Power Plant Database, geoBoundaries and World Bank data; raster extracts are reacquired with the supplied code.
